improvements: Refreshed complete mapped office, retail/podium and part contours in the original shared complex frame.
Removed an unverified roof plant addition above the 126 m source height.
Removed the invented detached bridge-landing block at Bellevue Square, preserving the actual mall footprint as its own source building.
Podium walls are cream / tan stone panels over a grey storefront base instead of brick-toned masonry; the NE 8th St name is dark lettering on the stone.
The Bellevue Way skybridge and the diagonal NE 8th St bridge (w1364249504) are glazed walkways inside open white steel trusses (posts every ~4 m with alternating diagonals).

On the Bellevue Way faces the upper podium is wide blue-glass bays between stone piers, the bay south of the Bellevue Square skybridge is red-brown brick, and brick piers stand between the shopfronts at the sidewalk (Street View at 47.61709 and 47.61647).
remainingGaps: Bridge decks, vertical clearance, facade mullion rhythm, retail glazing and roof equipment remain simplified or estimated.

The explicit-ID replacement path and source-preserving Bellevue data are integrated. Complete independent complex placement, vertical fit and neighbour/road clearance remain separate from these original model studies.
These are isolated front/top/oblique model studies, not matched street-eye Street View/aerial comparisons. They do not establish full-world, night, weather or seasonal parity.

The shared explicit-ID source-replacement implementation is integrated in production (2c73f3d986a4e52d85f5520ca6cb3d4b732f0d13). These studies retain their actual capture-era source and do not establish current district placement, road/body clearance, traffic/mirror budgets or seasonal parity. Registry entries outside a district list and context-only models with no replacement IDs do not replace neighbouring buildings.

Podium colours and the truss member sizes and spacing come from a street-level review used as viewed reference only; they are estimates, not measurements. The red-brick accent bay at the NE 8th skybridge landing named in the source comment is not modelled.
Only the Bellevue Way faces were reviewed: the NE 8th and court faces keep the earlier windows. Bay width (about 7.5 m), sill / head heights and the ends of the brick stretch are estimates.
